sections.text: By Rosie Morris and Michael Burman

This guide explains how individual and collective redundancies work, what your rights are and your employer’s obligations. This guide will take you through the steps and explain what needs to happen and what is needed from you and your employer. To read this guide please click the link below. This guide was written Rosie Morris and Michael Burman from Howard Kennedy LLP who support the Free Legal Advice Centre. The guide represents the views of the authors. Please note: This guide does not constitute legal advice or gives rise to a solicitor/client relationship.
